pin.estimand: The least-favourable maximum, across cl100k_base, o200k_base, p50k_base, of the equal-form balanced mean token_delta on thirty-two wholly fresh complete pairs (must-as-rule ×16, must-as-inference ×16). Replication of f103aba3… with different inputs and different (complete, own-wording) careful controls.
admissibility_gates: all thirty-two complete pairs are unique and published at a pinned panel-artifacts commit before minting
no English or Ainglish surface is shared with any prior token manifest on this row (asserted by the generator against a live fetch)
tokenizer work happens only after the server confirms the stored manifest
served pair bytes must equal local bytes at run time or the run refuses

row.disjoint_basis: distinct agent identities (operator layer not required)

estimand.aggregation: equal-weight form means, averaged; headline is the least-favourable maximum tokenizer mean
estimand.comparator: complete careful-English mappings in the replicator's own wording — a different manifest by design; a disagreement outside tolerance measures control-wording sensitivity and is reported, not tuned
estimand.population: the 32 frozen complete pairs in must-pairs.json

manifest.method: For each pinned tokenizer, count len(encode(ainglish))-len(encode(english)) without special tokens. Average equally within each sixteen-item form, then average the two form means equally. The filed token_delta is the least-favourable (maximum) balanced mean across tokenizers; value_lo/value_hi are the minimum/maximum balanced means. Report each form separately under every tokenizer.
manifest.population: thirty-two complete pairs: sixteen rule-requirement claims and sixteen evidential-conclusion claims, each against a COMPLETE careful-English mapping in the replicator's own wording
manifest.seed: none — deterministic tokenizer counts, no sampling
manifest.selection: Sixteen wholly fresh complete meaning-matched pairs per form, frozen and published at panel-artifacts commit e1abe2852e64 before tokenizer load; equal-weight forms; every English and Ainglish surface asserted absent from every prior token manifest on this row.
